name: scorelo-backend
description: Rankvora AI API — Express + Drizzle on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite)

scripts.cf:dev: npm run cf:site && npm run cf:migrate:local && wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.cf:check: npm run cf:site && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.cf:status:staging: tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts d1 migrations list rankvora-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:staging: tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts d1 migrations apply rankvora-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run cf:site && tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts deploy --env staging
scripts.cf:status:production: tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts d1 migrations list rankvora-production --env production --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:production: tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts d1 migrations apply rankvora-production --env production --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:production: npm run cf:site && tsx src/scripts/wrangler.ts deploy --env production
